answer.rationale: Current data shows activation down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4% QoQ. Memory_91 (activation messaging improved week-one engagement) directly addresses the activation decline and has proven durable impact without known renewal risk. Memory_31 (signup simplification lifted first-week activation) showed SMB improvement and complements activation work. Memory_86 (shortening onboarding improved completion) supports the onboarding metric decline. Promotional pricing (memory_73) is explicitly flagged as unsuitable for repeat use due to 12-point renewal damage. Referral incentives (memory_57) work well for *established* customers but won't help with new-account activation declines or compete with competitor entry pricing. Enterprise sales assist (memory_44) doesn't address the SMB-focused competitive pressure or current activation/onboarding deficits. Activation messaging offers highest-confidence lift on the core metric (activation) without the renewal risk of promotional pricing, and provides faster time-to-value signaling that improves onboarding perceived value. Standard_experiment scale allows measurement of sustained impact before full rollout.
